title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two thousand years after sacrificing himself to end a war between demons and humans, Demon King Anos (Anoth) is reincarnated to an ordinary couple. At the Demon King Academy his power is too great to measure, so he is labeled a misfit, and he finds his name forgotten and a society where royal 'pureblood' demons rule over hybrids. With his friend Misha, shunned by her own family, he sets out to unravel the false history. The manga ended after four volumes due to the artist's death.
life_message: Worth is not set by bloodline, and real strength protects peace, friends and family.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Challenges and duels settle disputes; Anos answers insults by demonstrating power (ANN).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Academy rules matter, but Anos disregards rankings that cannot measure him.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Anos says family should stick together; warm ties to his parents (ANN, Wikipedia).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Pureblood rank is attacked, yet a supreme demon king stands above all.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Inherited history is shown to be falsified.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: School life and comedy alongside battles.

folkways.japan: Academy rankings and inherited family status echo Japanese school and lineage hierarchies, which the overpowered transfer student overturns, a common light-novel pattern.

delivery.evidence: ANN: prejudice works as world-building, themes come through Anos's reflections; not called heavy-handed.

personified.ideology: worth beyond bloodline, backed by overwhelming power

delivery.note: Blood-purity prejudice is embodied by arrogant classmates and a teacher who are deflated by the hero, while Wikipedia (light novel) shows the teacher later seeing her mistakes.

winners_losers: Anos and the shunned hybrids win; pureblood elitists lose, sometimes being humiliated and sometimes coming to change.
